item.title: KATSEYE Shouts Out BTS for ‘Inspiring Us’ in New Artist of the Year Acceptance Speech at 2026 AMAs
item.description:
[Energetic music plays in the background]
Host: Welcome to the latest music news. The 2023 American Music Awards just wrapped up, and KATSEYE took home the award for New Artist of the Year. The global pop group beat out some tough competition, including Leon Thomas, Olivia Dean, and sombr.
[Short music transition]
Host: In their acceptance speech, the group gave a special shout-out to BTS for inspiring them to represent their culture on a global scale. KATSEYE also thanked key players like HYBE's Chairman Bang and Geffen Records CEO John Janick.
[Clip of "Pinky Up" by KATSEYE plays briefly]
Host: Earlier in the night, KATSEYE performed their latest single, "Pinky Up", which reached number 28 on the Billboard Hot 100. The song is a preview of their upcoming WILD EP, set to be released on August 14th.
[Short music transition]
Host: This big win makes KATSEYE the first girl group to win New Artist of the Year at the American Music Awards since the category was introduced in 2004. They're also set to support their new project with The Wildworld Tour, kicking off on September 1st in Dublin and wrapping up on November 28th in Mexico City.
[Closing music starts]
Host: Catch KATSEYE at Governors Ball in New York City, Hinterland Music Festival in Iowa, and Head in the Clouds in California. And that's the latest from the music world. Thanks for tuning in!
[Closing music continues to play until the end]
